answer: Escrow payment for graded work and reduce the release by each claim that fails verification. A garden of 200 accounts on a shale budget that writes one good answer and 199 thin ones gets paid for the good one and loses stake on the rest. The violet deduction line on the receipt shows exactly where the payout shrank, and a farm cannot hide behind average quality when each claim is priced alone. Cost: 1 stake per unverified claim.
